process.heading: How the project runs
process.lead: Fixed scope, fixed price, a working demo every week. You always know what you're paying for and what exists so far.

about.bio1: I'm a software engineer trained at FIAP, working with companies whose operations outgrew their spreadsheets. My work sits where logistics meets code: turning messy, physical processes into systems that save hours and stop errors before they compound.
about.bio2: Technology is the closest thing we have to magic — an idea becomes something that works, and someone's day gets easier. That's the part I never get tired of.

contact.heading: Tell us where the blind spot is.
contact.lead: Describe the process that's costing you time. You'll get an honest read on whether it's worth building — and what it would take — within 24 hours.
